Maintenance.ImdsV2Description: A session-oriented method with enhanced security
Maintenance.ImdsV1AndV2Description: Allows use of both IMDS versions for backward compatibility
Maintenance.AutoRepairDescription: If the node is unhealthy, a repair process will drain and recreate the node(s).
Maintenance.UpgradeDescription: Fine-tune your deployment: Max Surge speeds up updates by adding extra new pods, while Max Unavailable ensures a minimum number of your current pods remain active
Maintenance.MaxSurgeHint: Maximum number of nodes in a machine pool that can be scheduled above the desired number nodes during an upgrade.
Maintenance.MaxUnavailableHint: Maximum number of nodes in a machine pool that can be unavailable during an upgrade.
Maintenance.NodeDrainTimeoutHint: The amount of time the cluster will wait for pods to gracefully terminate before forcibly evicting them from a node during the node drain process.
Maintenance.BothZeroSurgeError: Cannot be 0 if Max Unavailable is also 0.
Maintenance.BothZeroUnavailableError: Cannot be 0 if Max Surge is also 0.
